source: Week 11 lecture (Trie): collecting all the words, autocomplete

tests.name: collect_all_words from the root
autocomplete
No match
tests.hint: Return an empty list, not None.

tests.name: Collect from a node
tests.hint: `word` is put in front of everything found below the node.

tests.name: Calling twice (mutable default)
tests.hint: A default argument like words=[] is shared by every call. Use words=None and make a new list inside.

tests.name: The prefix is a word
Empty prefix
20 000 words, 3 000 lookups
tests.data:
import random
random.seed(1103)
letters = 'abcdefgh'
words = [''.join(random.choices(letters, k=random.randint(4, 10))) for _ in range(20000)]
prefixes = [w[:random.randint(4, 6)] for w in random.sample(words, 3000)]
tests.setup:
t = Trie()
for w in words:
    t.insert(w)
results = [t.autocomplete(p) for p in prefixes]
tests.hint: Only collect below the prefix's node. Collecting the whole trie and filtering is too slow.
